name: Feeding America
story: $1,000 gives **{food-network: 1000 * share * people_reached / cost_total} people** donated food and helps them claim food benefits.
summary: The national office of the US network of more than 200 food banks and 60,000 pantries and meal programmes. It sources donated food from about 600 national food companies and retailers for its members, gives them grants and support, helps people apply for SNAP, and advocates on federal food programmes.

spending.source: https://www.feedingamerica.org/sites/default/files/2025-11/Feeding%20America_25%20FS_Final.pdf (fiscal year to 30 June 2025, p. 5): programme services before donated goods and services $454,930k, less the food procurement revenue members paid back for food bought on their behalf ($184,535k, p. 4) = $270,395k, Feeding America's own cash programme spending. The accounts' programme services of $5,113,994k also hold $4,659,064k of donated food, media and services at fair value: other organisations' resources, which the models count in Feeding America's share of the credit, not as its spending.

lines.label: Food sourcing, member food banks' support and SNAP help (member services, food procurement, programs)
lines.source: https://www.feedingamerica.org/sites/default/files/2025-11/Feeding%20America_25%20FS_Final.pdf (FY2025, p. 5): member services $99,312k + food procurement $269,521k + programs $37,222k, before donated goods, less the members' repayments for purchased food $184,535k (p. 4) = $221,520k, the model's program_spend.

lines.label: Policy and advocacy, research and analysis, public awareness and education
lines.source: https://www.feedingamerica.org/sites/default/files/2025-11/Feeding%20America_25%20FS_Final.pdf (FY2025, p. 5): policy and advocacy $15,389k + research and analysis $20,883k + public awareness and education $12,603k, before donated media = $48,875k, the model's program_spend.

lines.label: Donated food and media at fair value, and food bought for members at their cost (not paid by donations to Feeding America)
lines.source: https://www.feedingamerica.org/sites/default/files/2025-11/Feeding%20America_25%20FS_Final.pdf (FY2025, pp. 4-5 and note 6): $4,659,064k of donated food, media and services booked in programme services, and $184,535k of food and transport members paid for. Neither is paid for by gifts to Feeding America: the donated food enters the food network model's credit share as the donors' resource, so 0 here.
